headline: Brent Crude Rises 1.1% on Middle East Peace Uncertainty
summary: Brent crude futures for January delivery advanced 1.1% to trade at $99.31 per barrel in London amid ongoing uncertainty regarding Iran war peace progress.
why: Geopolitical tensions in key oil-producing regions threaten global supply stability, driving near-term volatility in crude prices.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical risks in the Middle East create supply concerns, lifting crude oil futures.
